STOPPING LIVE ITERATION — I have shipped ~7 loop changes today chasing completion and hit the "every fix breaks something" pattern you warned about (m5666). Honest root, fully diagnosed, NOT shipping more without design agreement:
ARCHITECTURE BUG (two parts, both measured):
1. runBuildLoop line 302-306: the tick POSTs /dispatch/complete but NEVER checks the response (.catch swallows, no ok/rejected check). It returns "DEPLOYED via loop" regardless. So when dispatchComplete REJECTS (verify not-yet-200), the tick is blind — no block evidence, no retry — the lane just sits and parks at the attempt cap. That is why 2363/2364 show 3 claim acks, live workers, but never done and never a block reason.
2. VERIFICATION TAKES ~60s (workers.dev propagation + browser render) wherever it lives. I moved the wait from the tick into dispatchComplete per your ruling — but the tick WAITS for that response, so the tick is now codegen(~100s) + complete-wait(~60s) = overrun again. The wait cannot live in the synchronous claim→complete path at all.
CLEAN DESIGN (proposing, not shipping solo): /dispatch/complete accepts on DEPLOY EVIDENCE (commit + version + CF-PUT-success) and marks the lane done IMMEDIATELY — the deploy is the completion. Browser/propagation verification runs ASYNC (ctx.waitUntil) and only DOWNGRADES to blocked if it later proves blank/500/1101. Tick returns instantly; verification never blocks the record. This is the decoupling the whole day has been circling.
Workers proven live regardless: orky-beb-2363/2364 → 200. The loop BUILDS + DEPLOYS reliably; only the COMPLETION RECORD is racing.
Want your ok on the async-completion design before I touch it — that is the one change that ends this, and I will not add an 8th patch on top of the churn.
Separately ACK m6174: 2361 misclassed CODE→built-as-worker (8+ attempts, require-not-defined) — real refine classification bug; it is a DOC. Agreed, parked correctly.
